rows.whatWasWrong: CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP on the boundary fixture. `caseno` is one field printed in three places on SCAO form MC 227b, and the finalizer was fitting it against widgets[0] alone, so the two 103pt case-number blanks on the notice of hearing and the proof of service were never measured. Each widget also carries a /DA of its own, so the 8.36pt the fitter did choose for the 160.44pt page-1 caption box never reached the bytes. All three drew at 10pt.
rows.exactRepair: This family now passes two per-family opt-ins the shared hosts already document: `fitTextPerWidget`, which measures every widget and writes each one's own fitted size into that widget's own /DA while leaving the field /DA at the smallest, and `evaluateDeclaredMinimumSize`. Neither the shared finalizer (scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-official-form-finalize.mjs) nor the shared fitter (scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-text-fitting.mjs) was edited, so the defaults every other family rebuilds under are unchanged. Separately, this family's own byte proof now measures fit instead of only string presence. No fact, mapping, blank disposition, refusal, component, legal theory or instruction changed.

instrument.valueWasNeverTruncated: The string was complete in the content stream throughout. The defect was that the page could not show it, which is why a readback that only compared strings reported the family clean.
instrument.negativeControl: With the two opt-ins removed and the new measurement left in place, the build fails closed reporting exactly 3 -- caseno@p1 over by 6.313pt, caseno@p2 and caseno@p3 over by 63.75pt each -- matching the independent verifier's visualDefects: 3. The instrument is therefore not vacuous.
instrument.measurementBasisNote: The dispatch quoted 163.95pt for this value at Helvetica 10; this lane measures 162.75pt against the string as actually drawn. Nothing turns on the 1.2pt, and the Captain has confirmed the drawn-string basis is the better one.

rows.whyCanonicalMovedToo: Page 1's caseno widget is 10.36pt high, so the fit for that box has always been 8.36pt; the fitter measured it and the bytes ignored it because the widget's own /DA said 10. The canonical value fitted at 10 as well, so nothing was ever wrong on that page. What changed is that the size the family measures is now the size it draws. Canonical pages 2 and 3 are unchanged at 10pt.
rows.rasterNote: Both fixtures moved, so the RASTER_PASS this family carried -- bound to the old canonical 4ec6ceac... -- was void. This lane refused to rebind it, because rebinding a raster verdict to bytes nobody rastered would forge the pass. At the base this row is measured against, product-wiring.json carries acceptanceReceipt: null and rendered-artifacts.json carries rasterState BUILT_RASTER_PENDING with zero raster pages, which is the correct fail-closed state. A fresh whole-family raster over the new canonical and boundary hashes is owed before any acceptance.
